## 4. GrowMoE: does it route to specialised experts, and is the routing consistent?

Per run on the held-out grid (every example is routed to one expert). NMI = how much knowing the expert tells you about the operator / output slot / length (0 = nothing, 1 = everything); purity = share of an operator's examples that go to that operator's most common expert; `experts` = experts alive at the end of training.

| learner | protocol | regime | seed | experts | used on test | NMI operator | NMI slot | NMI length | purity (operator) | abstain (unknown) % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GrowMoE-h512-s5-r20000 | iid | FULL | 0 | 2 | 2 | 0.01 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 55.9 | 0.0 |

**Reading the same trained pool out in groups**: the output slots of one problem share the operands and the operator, so they can be answered together by the expert most of them chose on their own (the stage-3b group vote, with its per-input veto). Same trained pool, no retraining. Exact match % on unseen problems, individual vs grouped, and the routing statistics of the grouped read-out.

| learner | protocol | regime | seed | exact: individual | exact: grouped | NMI operator (grouped) | NMI slot (grouped) | purity (grouped) | experts used (grouped) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GrowMoE-h512-s5-r20000 | iid | FULL | 0 | 9.8 | 12.9 | 0.02 | 0.00 | 60.3 | 2 |

**Consistency** (adjusted Rand index between the routing of two runs on the same test examples; 1 = identical partition, 0 = unrelated): across seeds (same learner, protocol, regime) and across training-length regimes (same learner, protocol, seed).

| learner | protocol | comparison | ARI |
|---|---|---|---|
| - | - | (needs two seeds or two regimes) | - |

**Specialist reuse for new lengths** (HOLE / SHORT runs): share of the new-length examples routed to the expert that handles the same (operator, output slot) most often on the in-training lengths; abstention rate on in-training vs new lengths; AUROC of the novelty p-value for telling new-length examples from in-length ones (0.5 = cannot tell).

| learner | protocol | regime | seed | reuse of the in-length specialist | abstain on in-length % | abstain on new length % | AUROC new vs in length |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
